remarks: Waterfront living at its finest! Discover an exceptional lifestyle with effortless, low-maintenance living at Dorlon Terrace, a hidden waterfront gem tucked within the East Norwalk enclave of Gregory Point. Just moments from the Shore & Country Club and surrounded by beautiful coastal homes. This meticulously maintained 2-3 bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse delivers the spacious feel of single-family living with all the convenience of a well-managed community. From the moment you step inside, abundant natural light and breathtaking water views greet you at every turn, this condo truly says "welcome home." The open-concept living area is perfect for both relaxed daily living and seamless entertaining, effortlessly blending indoor comfort with outdoor enjoyment. Open the sliding doors from the living room to your private terrace and soak in the serene marina views-ideal for unwinding with a book, or hosting friends while enjoying the fresh sea air. The spacious primary suite is a true retreat, complete with its own private balcony overlooking the harbor and out to the Long Island Sound. A perfect spot for sunrise coffee or sunset cocktails. All bedrooms feature generous walk-in closets. Note that a previous owner expanded the primary suite; however, a straightforward restoration of the third bedroom wall with a provided estimate of just $1,500 allows easy conversion back to a true 3-bedroom layout, complete with shared balcony access & stunning water views
